normalization_method: log2 median centering: subtract each sample's log2 median from all proteins in that sample (final pass on the complete matrix so every sample median is exactly 0)
imputation_method: condition-aware protein replication: mean of the two same-protein, same-condition (Control or Treated) replicates in centered log2 space
processing_order: log2 -> sample median centering -> condition-aware imputation -> final sample median re-centering
